project_info.color_palette: Warm white, light beige, bright red, orange glow

main_subject.detail: A minimal leaderboard-reward poster with the headline 'Thuong Top Giao dich'. Supporting copy says 'Khi co so luong giao dich hop le nhanh nhat va nhieu nhat trong thang(*)'. In the center, several glossy red U-point coins are stacked on a glowing red-orange podium block labeled '2 Trieu U-Point/thang'. The legal note at bottom right says '(*) Ap dung cho khach hang co tu 300 giao dich hop le tro len'. The Techcombank logo is placed at the top right over a pale background with faint translucent diamond shapes.
